title: Reel: Back in 2004, email seemed like a solved problem. But an engineer at Google had different ideas...

timeline.caption: Aaron Swartz: Gmail's Search Revolution in 2004
Yet, an engineer named Aaron Swartz saw its potential
He introduced Gmail’s search feature, revolutionizing how we find emails
This simple change turned Gmail into the world’s most used email service and inspired innovation in other apps by Google
Clone this repo or follow for more on Google's Email Renaissance.
